title: FILOCLL017 - NEVOTAL : Nemtabrutinib in addition to Venetoclax-Obinutuzumab in chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) / small lymphocytic leukemia (SLL) patients with TP53 ALterations
official: FILOCLL017 - NEVOTAL : Nemtabrutinib in addition to Venetoclax-Obinutuzumab in chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) / small lymphocytic leukemia (SLL) patients with TP53 ALterations
summary: Main objective: The primary objective of the study is to determine the efficacy of the nemtabrutinib-VO (NVO) regimen at day 1 cycle 16, which corresponds to the completion of 15 cycles of nemtabrutinib, 12 cycles of venetoclax and 6 cycles of obinutuzumab.
conditions: Patients with previously untreated chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or / small lymphocytic leukemia (SLL) requiring therapy according to iwCLL 2018 criteria with TP53 abnormalities (either 17p deletion by fluorescence in situ hybridization [FISH] and/or chromosome banding array [CBA] or TP53 mutations).

interventions.name: Gazyvaro 1,000 mg concentrate for solution for infusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Confirmed diagnosis of chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) / small lymphocytic leukemia (SLL) requiring therapy according to iwCLL 2018 criteria
2. At least 1 of the following markers of disease burden: (i) malignant lymph nodes attributable to CLL/SLL, which are clearly and reproducibly measurable in 2 dimensions in the axial plane, and measure >1.5 cm in longest diameter when assessed by CT/MRI scan; (ii) absolute lymphocyte count > 4 x 10^9/L; (iii) platelet count <100 x 10^9/L; (iv) hemoglobin <11 g/dL.
3. Presence of TP53 abnormalities (either 17p deletion by fluorescence in situ hybridization [FISH] and/or chromosome banding array [CBA] or TP53 mutations), whatever is the percentage of abnormal cells with a positivity threshold of 1%.
4. Have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 2.  Evaluation of ECOG is to be performed within 7 days prior to the first dose of study intervention.
5. Adequate organ function
6. Ability to understand the purpose and risks of the study and provide signed and dated informed
Exclusion criteria:
1. Active uncontrolled autoimmune hemolytic anemia or idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura
2. Active CNS involvement.
3. History or current evidence of any condition, therapy, or laboratory abnormality that might confound the results of the study, interfere with the participant’s participation for the full duration of the study, or is not in the best interest of the participant to participate, in the opinion of the treating investigator.
4. Clinically significant, uncontrolled cardiac, cardiovascular disease or history of myocardial infarction within 6 months prior to inclusion, or QTc prolongation (defined as a QTcF >450 msecs) or other significant ECG abnormalities including second degree AV block type II, third degree AV block, or bradycardia (ventricular rate less than 50 beats/min). Correction of suspected drug-induced QTcF prolongation can be attempted at the Investigator’s discretion and only if clinically safe to do so.
5. Currently being treated with the following drugs: a. P-gp substrates with a narrow therapeutic index; b. CYP3A strong inducers; c. CYP3A strong inhibitors.
